definitions.explanation: A cosmetic or medicinal substance intended to lighten the skin or reduce dark spots and pigmentation.

examples.japanese: {美白剤|びはくざい}を{肌|はだ}に{塗|ぬ}る。
examples.english: Apply whitening agent to the skin.

examples.japanese: この{化粧品|けしょうひん}には{美白剤|びはくざい}が{含|ふく}まれている。
examples.english: This cosmetic contains a whitening agent.

examples.japanese: {美白剤|びはくざい}は、シミやそばかすを{目立|めだ}たなくする{目的|もくてき}で{使|つか}われる。
examples.english: Whitening agents are used to make spots and freckles less noticeable.

notes:
Compound of {美白|びはく} (skin whitening, lit. "beautiful white") and the suffix {剤|ざい} (agent, preparation).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美白剤|びはくざい}{入|い}りの{化粧品|けしょうひん}: cosmetics containing a whitening agent
- {美白|びはく}{効果|こうか}: whitening effect

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {美白|びはく}{化粧品|けしょうひん}: whitening cosmetics — the finished products
- {薬用|やくよう}{美白|びはく}: medicated whitening — regulated products with active ingredients
